question: Who is the author of the book ‘The History and Stars of the World’s Greatest Sporting Event: From Athens 1896 to Paris 2024’, launched at New Delhi World Book Fair, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijayan Bala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vijayan Bala** is a well-known author and cricket statistician, recognized for his contributions to sports literature in India.
 
• The book titled **"The History and Stars of the World's Greatest Sporting Event: From Athens 1896 to Paris 2024"** provides an in-depth account of the history of the Olympic Games, covering events from its inception in Athens in **1896** to the upcoming Olympics in Paris **2024**.
 
• This book was **launched during the New Delhi World Book Fair in 2025**, a prominent event showcasing literature and authors from across the globe.
 
• Vijayan Bala is known for his detailed research and statistical analysis, which adds credibility and depth to his works, particularly in the realm of **sports history**.
